external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Prince & Izant is committed to providing the best in brazing support and education. In August of 2023, Prince & Izant demonstrated that commitment by acquiring Kay & Associates, the worldwide leader in brazing seminars. These 3-day regional production brazing seminars provide intensive training in all forms and brazing methods for base materials ranging from aluminum to titanium to ceramics.
